text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tact-san! Thank you so much for 
recommending that waterfall the other day!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, from the mixer... No, thank you as 
well. Your story about the cavern deep in 
the mountains was very fascinating.
choice_data_list:
If I recall, you found it after getting 
lost...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, exactly! Trainer-san listened to so 
many of our stories too, thank you so 
much. It was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The other day, an all-grades student mixer 
was organized and held by Daring Heart and 
the others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere was welcoming, creating a 
space where anyone could casually chat 
with anyone else. And right at the center 
of it all was—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Even though everyone gathered wanted to 
mingle, I was pretty nervous at first... 
but then Heart-san came over and talked to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
And then people gathered around us, and 
before I knew it, I was chatting with so 
many different people!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It really is mysterious. People just 
naturally gather around her.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... how should I put it? She's just so 
undeniably charming, you know? Before I 
know it, my eyes are always following her.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
How can someone become like that? Maybe I 
should try imitating Heart-san?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Imitate... her? Her nobility, her 
steadfast heart... Those kinds of 
qualities, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, when it comes to Heart-san, her 
number one charm has gotta be that 
sparkling smile of hers, right? Don't you 
think?
choice_data_list: Well, her dignified presence is also...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ that's true too. But if we're talking 
about the best thing, hmm~

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
... Everyone has a different perspective, 
I see.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ............ ... Her greatest... charm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The fact that she has so many friends, I 
think...! She's so fun to talk to, her 
smile is so sparkling, and she's just a 
truly wonderful horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be that she never lies! She's 
always honest. That's the true mark of a 
hero!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Her strong mental fortitude, perhaps. 
I've never seen her show any sign of 
weakness.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! So you got curious and went around 
asking all kinds of people? Oh, you really 
are such an interesting person!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I apologize... I just couldn't help being 
curious.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
However, everyone's opinions differed... 
There was nothing that could definitively 
be called number one.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I see. What about you? What do you 
think is the charm that makes me shine the 
brightest?
choice_data_list: It's hard to narrow it down to one...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: Heart-san herself... you mean?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Does that mean... every single 
charming trait is contained within the 
vessel that is "me"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That is the absolute best answer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to think about which one 
is the greatest. After all—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My! What a lovely compliment. Though 
there's no need to stress over it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Because after all, that's just who I am!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to think about which one 
is the greatest. After all—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! That's right, that's simply who I 
am!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to think about which one 
is the greatest. After all—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Everyone discovers their own unique 
sparkle through their own unique gaze.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to remain someone who 
radiates endless facets of brilliance 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So that from now on and always, people can 
continue looking for my "greatest charm."

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: I... see.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I understand now. You have the 
natural confidence... to simply embrace 
everything as a matter of course.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...No wonder you're so dazzling.
